create_zero_redundancy_optimizer: create a ZeroRedundancyOptimizer that shards optimizer states across ranks to reduce per-rank memory
run_zero_redundancy_optimizer_step: run a ZeroRedundancyOptimizer step that performs a local optimizer update and syncs parameter shards across all ranks
build_consolidate_state_dict: build a consolidated optimizer state dict on a target rank by gathering sharded states from all ranks
test_zero_redundancy_state_dict: test the ZeroRedundancyOptimizer state_dict method that returns the global optimizer state known to this rank
review_zero_redundancy_load_state_dict: review the ZeroRedundancyOptimizer load_state_dict method that loads sharded optimizer state for this rank
